lines.en: label christmastwo1:
scene wakanareturns1
And so another day comes to an end with absolutely nothing happening.
lines.zh: 于是，又一天就这么结束了，什么事也没发生。

lines.en: It’s almost as if becoming a teacher isn’t really as exciting as most people make it out to be.
lines.zh: 几乎就像是在说，当老师其实并不像大多数人渲染的那样令人兴奋。

lines.en: Granted, I’m no stranger when it comes to traversing paths that most would find impassable.
lines.zh: 诚然，在走那些多数人认为走不通的路这件事上，我并不陌生。

lines.en: Or at least I think that's the case.
lines.zh: 至少我觉得是这样。

lines.en: I’m not the best when it comes to figuring out how the people around me feel but, then again, that’s something I’ve willed myself into doing simply because I like walking alone a little better.
lines.zh: 我不太擅长弄清身边人的感受，不过话说回来，那也是我自己心甘情愿选择的结果——只因为我更喜欢一个人走。

lines.en: I guess what I’m trying to get at here is that some days are good.
lines.zh: 我想我想说的是，有些日子是好的。

lines.en: And others?
lines.zh: 而另一些呢？

lines.en: Well-
Saying they don’t matter is the nice way of putting it.
lines.zh: 说它们不重要，算是客气的说法了。

lines.en: Today is one of those days- where I’m acutely aware of my state of being and how remarkably pointless it is from the perspective of some other person behind some other desk.
lines.zh: 今天就是那样的一天——我异常清醒地意识到自己的存在状态，以及从某个坐在另一张办公桌后的另一个人看来，它是多么惊人地毫无意义。

lines.en: But, at least there’s only one more day of this until the weekly cycle of self-induced apathy and student-induced orgasms starts over.
lines.zh: 不过，至少再撑一天，那套由自我催生的冷漠与学生催生的高潮所组成的每周循环，就又要重新开始了。

lines.en: Thankfully, this weekend comes fully equipped with yet another get together that I’m positive won’t result in any sort of drama or rivalry between classmates.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，这个周末还附带了又一场聚会——我敢肯定，它绝不会引发同学之间任何形式的闹剧或争风吃醋。

lines.en: After all, nothing bad ever happens as a result of those.
lines.zh: 毕竟，那种事从来没闹出过什么坏事。

lines.en: And nothing bad ever happens on Christmas.
lines.zh: 而且圣诞节也从来不会出什么坏事。

lines.en: So, all things considered, I think I can count on making some memories that may or may not crush and/or consume the ones this mind used to hold.
lines.zh: 所以，综合考虑下来，我觉得自己大概能指望制造出一些回忆——它们也许会、也许不会把这颗脑子过去装着的东西碾碎、又或者吞掉。

lines.en: And, even more things considered-
lines.zh: 而且，再综合考虑一下——

lines.en: I wonder how much longer I can keep this up for.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己还能撑多久。

lines.en: {i}Welcome to the second Lessons in Love special Christmas update!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到 Lessons in Love 的第二个圣诞特别更新！{/i}

lines.en: {i}The next twenty-something events will play in succession.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}接下来的二十多个事件会依次播放。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Now, I know what you’re thinking.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在，我知道你在想什么。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Why is this chain of events starting on a Thursday? And why is it starting in an office completely devoid of all traces of Christmas spirit?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}为什么这一串事件要从星期四开始？又为什么是在一间完全没有一丝圣诞气氛的办公室里开始？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Well, unfortunately, I don’t have an answer for you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}嗯，很遗憾，这个问题我没有答案。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But, you see- sometimes, it’s the average days that don’t carry any sort of weight that wind up completely changing everything we know when we look back on them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但你要知道——有时候，恰恰是那些毫无分量的平凡日子，在你回头看的时候，彻底改变了你所知道的一切。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And hey, maybe this random Thursday will be one of those days.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而且嘿，也许这个随随便便的星期四，就会是那种日子之一。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Or maybe I’m just bullshitting you and this really won’t matter at all when everything is said and done.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}又或者我只是在跟你胡扯，等一切都尘埃落定，这事其实根本无关紧要。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I guess we never really know until things are said and done, though, huh?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过我想，在尘埃落定之前，我们永远也不会真的知道，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Anyway, I’ll leave you alone for now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}总之，我先不打扰你了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please cherish this Christmas- for you never know how many of them you have left.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请珍惜这个圣诞节——因为你永远不知道自己还剩几个。{/i}

lines.en: While I nodded, nearly napping, suddenly there came a tapping.
lines.zh: 正当我点头、几乎要打起盹来时，忽然传来一阵叩击声。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 请进。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns2
: Pardon the intrusion.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打扰了。

lines.en: : Woah. Hey.
lines.zh: : 哇。嗨。

lines.en: : Can’t say I expected to see you today.
lines.zh: : 真没想到今天会见到你。

lines.en: : Please hold your applause. I’m not returning to school until this coming Monday. I just came by to check on my office plants.
lines.zh: : 掌声就免了。我要到这周一才回学校。我只是过来看看办公室里的植物。

lines.en: : Oh, and to do this.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有来做这个。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns3
: I am terribly sorry for the commotion I must have caused during your strange, winter beach trip.
lines.zh: : 我在你那场古怪的冬日海滩之旅期间，一定闹出了不小的动静，对此我深表歉意。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine you dwelled too much on it seeing as you made no attempt to contact neither myself nor my significant other during my stay in the hospital-
lines.zh: : 我住院那阵子，你既没试着联系我、也没联系我的另一半，我想你大概没太把这事放在心上——

lines.en: : But I don’t blame you at all on account of the position my actions must have put you in.
lines.zh: : 但我一点也不怪你，毕竟我的行为把你置于了那样的境地。

lines.en: : It was a mistake. A bad one.
lines.zh: : 那是个错误。一个严重的错误。

lines.en: : And if there is anything I can do to prevent it from having a long-lasting effect on our friendship, please let me know.
lines.zh: : 如果有什么我能做的，能让它不至于对我们的友谊产生长久的影响，请告诉我。

lines.en: : So it is a friendship after all.
lines.zh: : 所以到头来，这果然还是友谊啊。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns4
: Well, yes. I thought that was obvious.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。我以为这很明显。

lines.en: : You don’t have to apologize, Wakana. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 你不用道歉，Wakana。没事的。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns5
: No, it’s not fine. And I do have to apologize.
lines.zh: : 不，这事没完。我也必须道歉。

lines.en: : Even if {i}you{/i} don’t personally care, I’m sure some of your students may have been quite frightened by the event.
lines.zh: : 就算{i}你{/i}本人不在乎，我相信你的某些学生一定被那件事吓得不轻。

lines.en: : I should never have placed anyone in that position, and not apologizing for it would weigh on me greater than the bulk of life itself.
lines.zh: : 我本就不该把任何人置于那种境地，若不为此道歉，压在我心上的重量会比生命本身还重。

lines.en: : Can you stop assuming I don’t personally care just because I didn’t go out of my way to contact you?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别因为我没有特意去联系你，就断定我本人不在乎？

lines.en: scene wakanareturns6
: I’d be willing to accept Miyamura as a token of your apology.
lines.zh: : 我倒愿意接受以 Miyamura 作为你道歉的诚意。

lines.en: : I’m serious. What would I have even said if I {i}did{/i} contact you?
lines.zh: : 我是认{i}真的{/i}。我要是真联系你了，又能说什么？

lines.en: scene wakanareturns7
: Hello, Wakana. Glad to hear you’re...still alive?
lines.zh: : 你好啊，Wakana。很高兴听到你还……活着？

lines.en: : It’s not the most eloquent way of wording it, but you have experience in writing, so I’m sure you’d figure something out.
lines.zh: : 这话说得不算最文雅，不过你有写作的经验，我相信你能想出点什么来。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns8
: I won’t be petty about it, though. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会在这事上计较。没事的。

lines.en: : You seemed pretty petty just a few seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 你几秒钟前还挺计较的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, I want to fucking die. Not literally, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊，嗯，我他妈想死。当然不是字面意义上的。

lines.en: : Osako has asked that I add that clause whenever I utter those words as she’s still understandably shaken up over the whole thing.
lines.zh: : Osako 要求我每次说出那句话时都加上这个补充说明，因为整件事显然把她吓坏了。

lines.en: : Would you mind...explaining what happened, maybe? I still don’t really understand what went down.
lines.zh: : 你介意……解释一下发生了什么吗？我到现在都不太明白到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: : I didn’t even know you were on drugs until I woke up and heard that you were rushed to the hospital.
lines.zh: : 直到我醒来、听说你被紧急送进了医院，我才知道你那时在嗑药。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns9
: I’m not {i}on drugs-{/i} and this may be hard to believe given the type of person that I’ve painted myself to be, but I wasn’t trying to kill myself either.
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}嗑药{/i}——而且考虑到我把自己塑造成的那类人，这话可能很难让人相信，但我也没打算自杀。

lines.en: : I just took a little too much of my pain medication and it caused my body to temporarily shut down.
lines.zh: : 我只是止痛药吃多了一点点，导致身体暂时停摆了。

lines.en: : That sounds like more than just a “little too much.”
lines.zh: : 听起来可不止是「一点点」吧。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns10
: Yeah, I'm aware. And I’ve spent essentially every conscious minute since then apologizing for it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我知道。而且从那以后，我几乎每一个清醒的分钟都在为此道歉。

lines.en: : If I could go back and just deal with it, I would. But that ship has sailed and carried us off to the middle of nowhere, and now I just want to go home.
lines.zh: : 如果我能回到过去，就那么扛过去，我愿意。可那艘船已经开走了，把我们载到了荒无人烟的地方，而我现在只想回家。

lines.en: : I have a problem. It is no fault of yours, nor is it any fault of Osako’s, but I need you to understand that it is not something I wanted or asked for.
lines.zh: : 我有问题。这不是你的错，也不是 Osako 的错，但我需要你明白：这不是我想要、也不是我自找的东西。

lines.en: : Hey, I was just being a little sarcastic. You don’t have to freak out.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只是有点挖苦你而已。你不用激动。

lines.en: : I’m not-
lines.zh: : 我没有——

lines.en: scene wakanareturns11
: Ugh.
: And now the {i}lack{/i} of medication is causing me to speak out of turn.
lines.zh: : 现在{i}药效退{/i}了，反倒让我说了些不该说的话。

lines.en: : There’s truly no winning in this world, is there?
lines.zh: : 这世上真是怎么都赢不了，对吧？

lines.en: : Nope, but there’s certainly losing. And you came pretty damn close to doing that at the beach.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但输是肯定有的。而且你在海滩上差点就输了个彻底。

lines.en: : So just...be good or whatever and don’t almost kill yourself again and I’m sure everything will be just fine.
lines.zh: : 所以你就……乖一点什么的，别再差点把自己弄死了，我相信一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns12
: ...Yeah.
: You know, if you didn’t spend virtually all of your free time committing heinous acts on high school girls, you might actually be a decent person.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，如果你不是把所有空闲时间都用来对高中女生干些伤天害理的事，你其实可能会是个不错的人。

lines.en: : And if you didn’t spend all of your free time binding and gagging my karate instructor, you might find that you’re into the same sort of stuff that I am.
lines.zh: : 而如果你不是把所有空闲时间都用来捆绑、堵住我空手道老师的嘴，你也许会发现，我们其实喜欢的是同一类东西。

lines.en: : Which isn’t me admitting anything, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，这可不是我在承认什么。

lines.en: : I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我猜也是。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns13
: {i}Ahem...{/i}
: Oh, look. A conveniently timed knock that prevents this conversation from going somewhere unfavorable.
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧。一阵来得恰到好处的敲门声，正好阻止了这场对话往不利的方向发展。

lines.en: : Yo, let me in! I have to tell you about a thing!
lines.zh: : 哟，让我进去！我有件事要告诉你！

lines.en: : Unless you’re helping some student with her problems or something! If that’s the case, I’m sorry and I will wait!
lines.zh: : 除非你正在帮哪个学生解决她的问题什么的！那样的话我很抱歉，我可以等！

lines.en: : It’s fine. You can come in.
lines.zh: : 没事。你进来吧。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns14
: What, am I not cool enough to get invited to your secret teacher meetings or something?
lines.zh: : 什么，我还不够格被邀请参加你们的秘密教师会议之类的吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, but I think Wakana coming back means that you’re officially unemployed again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过我想 Wakana 一回来，就意味着你又正式失业了。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns15
: What?! She’s back?! But I had a whole ‘nother month of cool shit planned!
lines.zh: : 什么？！她回来了？！可我还有整整一个月的酷事计划呢！

lines.en: : Ahh. You must be the one who replaced me, then.
lines.zh: : 啊。那你一定就是接替我的人了。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns16
: Imani Imai. You’re...Wakana Watabe, right?
lines.zh: : Imani Imai。你是……Wakana Watabe，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes, but...what are we doing with our hands, exactly?
lines.zh: : 是的，不过……我们这手到底在干什么？

lines.en: : Bonding. We’re friends now.
lines.zh: : 交流感情。我们现在是朋友了。

lines.en: : We are?
lines.zh: : 我们是？

lines.en: scene wakanareturns17
: Yeah. All three of us are. We’re like those three amigos or whatever. Just instead of fighting people with swords and stuff, we fight them with {i}information.{/i}
lines.zh: : 对。我们三个都是。我们就像那三个好朋友什么的。只不过别人是用剑之类的打架，我们是用{i}信息{/i}打架。

lines.en: : I think you're thinking of the three musketeers.
lines.zh: : 你想的应该是三个火枪手吧。

lines.en: : I take it you two have already gotten acquainted, then?
lines.zh: : 看来你们两位已经互相认识过了？

lines.en: : She just kind of showed up while Noriko was pouring her heart out to me in school the other day.
lines.zh: : 前几天 Noriko 在学校对我掏心掏肺的时候，她就那么冒出来了。

lines.en: : Noriko?
lines.zh: : Noriko？

lines.en: : The anarchist girl that you pawned off on me.
lines.zh: : 你甩给我的那个无政府主义女孩。

lines.en: : Oh.
: She’s still fawning over you to that extent? I had assumed that was just a one time thing.
lines.zh: : 她还对你迷恋到那种程度？我还以为那只是一时的事。

lines.en: : She’s gotten...better.
lines.zh: : 她已经……好多了。

lines.en: : You two married yet? Because I don’t remember getting a wedding invite.
lines.zh: : 你们俩结婚了吗？因为我不记得收到过婚礼请柬。

lines.en: : We are not, no. Nor are we going to be any time soon.
lines.zh: : 没有，没有。而且短期内也不会。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns18
: Are you going to come too? You seem pretty close to this guy since you came to his office before even dropping by your classroom.
lines.zh: : 你也要来吗？你跟这家伙看起来挺熟的，毕竟你连教室都没去，先来了他的办公室。

lines.en: : Wait, did you really come straight to my-
lines.zh: : 等等，你真的直接来我的——

lines.en: : Miss...Imai, would you be willing to fill me in on what you’ve been teaching my class during my leave of absence?
lines.zh: : Imai 小姐，不知你是否愿意跟我说说，我休假期间你都教了我班上些什么？

lines.en: : Or just ignore me. That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆无视我。也行。

lines.en: : You can call me Imani, it’s cool. And they’re doing great, actually.
lines.zh: : 你可以叫我 Imani，没关系的。而且他们表现得很棒，真的。

lines.en: : I will admit that I may have veered a {i}little{/i} far off the curriculum, but that’s kinda just how I do stuff.
lines.zh: : 我承认我可能偏离教学大纲{i}有点{/i}远，不过我做事本来就是这个风格。

lines.en: : So my bad if everyone is suddenly like, really knowledgeable about the Crusades and praying mantises and shit.
lines.zh: : 所以如果大家突然间对十字军东征啊、螳螂啊什么的特别了解，那就抱歉啦。

lines.en: : Those...are certainly strange topics to specialize in.
lines.zh: : 那些……可真是够奇怪的专精方向。

lines.en: : You all good now, Wakana? You were in the hospital, right?
lines.zh: : 你现在都好了吗，Wakana？你之前住院了，对吧？

lines.en: scene wakanareturns19
: Well enough to return to school, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我想，已经好到能回学校的程度了。

lines.en: : Which means that, come Monday, you’ll likely be moved to a temporary position or something along those lines.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，到了周一，你很可能会被调到某个临时岗位，或者类似的位置。

lines.en: : You think?
lines.zh: : 你这么想？

lines.en: scene wakanareturns20
: Quite often. Though, I can’t say the thoughts are always colorful or jubilant.
lines.zh: : 经常想。不过，我得说那些念头并不总是五彩斑斓、欢天喜地的。

lines.en: : And what do you think, Sensei? Where will I wind up?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得呢，老师？我会落到什么位置？

lines.en: : New school nurse? Vice principal? Janitor?
lines.zh: : 新任校医？副校长？清洁工？

lines.en: : For your own safety, I hope you don’t wind up as the janitor.
lines.zh: : 为了你自身的安全起见，我希望你别去当清洁工。

lines.en: : Our school has a strange history of losing members of the custodial staff to freak accidents or, on some occasions, manslaughter.
lines.zh: : 我们学校有一段诡异的历史——后勤员工会因为离奇事故、有时甚至是过失杀人而减员。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns21
: Well, damn. I thought Japanese schools were supposed to be safe. I didn’t realize I was walking into some kind of murder zone when I took this job.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。我还以为日本的学校应该很安全呢。我接下这份工作时，可没意识到自己是踏进了某种凶杀区。

lines.en: : Where are you from, if you don’t mind me asking?
lines.zh: : 不介意我问一句，你是哪里人？

lines.en: : Switzerland.
lines.zh: : 瑞士。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Wales.
lines.zh: : 威尔士。

lines.en: : Alabama.
lines.zh: : 阿拉巴马。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns22
: Okay, fine. I moved here from Ghana right before the city was closed off.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧。我是在城市被封锁前不久从加纳搬过来的。

lines.en: : I just thought it would be funny to name all of the whitest places I could think of since you don’t really have many teachers that look like me here.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，把我能想到的最白的地方都报一遍会挺好笑的，因为你们这儿长得像我的老师实在不多。

lines.en: : And by {i}many{/i} I mean literally none. It’s just me.
lines.zh: : 说{i}不多{/i}，其实是完全没有。就我一个。

lines.en: : Is that something you’re not comfortable with?
lines.zh: : 这让你不舒服吗？

lines.en: scene wakanareturns23
: Oh, no. I’m totally cool with it. Just an awkward attempt at humor, I guess. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。我完全没意见。大概只是个尴尬的玩笑尝试吧。我也不知道。

lines.en: : Even though I’ve been here for a few years now, I still don’t really have any friends. And I just thought it’d be kinda cool if like, you know, all three of us could hang out sometime or something.
lines.zh: : 虽然我来这儿已经好几年了，但我还是没什么朋友。我只是觉得，如果……你知道的，我们三个哪天能一起出去玩什么的，应该挺酷的。

lines.en: scene wakanareturns24

lines.en: In fact, thinking rarely ever does anything to begin with.

lines.en: I’ll just continue to go with the flow, hang out with a small group of coworkers like a normal functioning adult, and see how things play out from here.
